en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a beach scene with fishing boats drawn up on the sand in the foreground, nets and gear spread out, and a man working on a net. Behind them is a wooden pier or sea bridge with many people strolling, some holding umbrellas. The text at the bottom identifies the place as Misdroy and notes that the view is in front of the sea pier. Publisher information is printed along the lower edge.
